name: v165_callput_cfi_balanced_lsus
hypothesis: KPb5bkwN and mL87NgRK both have strong headline metrics and low mutual PnL correlation, but each fails LOW_SUB_UNIVERSE. A balanced option-convexity + CFI-update blend tests whether two independent unstable sleeves can stabilize each other without becoming an existing ACTIVE sibling.
